name: Natsu Matsuri
blurb: Lebanon's biggest anime festival in Beirut with cosplay competitions, game tournaments and a Japanese-culture district.
notes: Found while researching the Gulf/Levant fixup task (not previously in series.json/pipeline/research). Organized by Kaliko Friends (anime store/events group); no independent website found, only Instagram (@kaliko.friends, bio: 'Next Event Natsu Matsuri 2026... Lebanon's Biggest Anime Festival, Cosplay - Games - Tournaments') and Facebook, so the Instagram page is used as url and cover is left null per the social-only rule. The 2026 edition's Sept 12-13 dates and Ava Venue/Achrafieh location are reported consistently by secondary coverage (Beirut.com-style event sites); the Instagram bio itself did not show the exact dates when fetched, so this is slightly less certain than a primary-source confirmation. No 2027 date is announced yet.
